CustomField.description: The fixed amount billed each month under this contract. FSD 5.10.3 describes these services as the fixed monthly shape with no meter and no consumption, so a recurring amount replaces readings and charge lines entirely.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The recurring monthly charge, not an annual total and not a one off. If the amount changes, update it here and note the effective date, since only the current amount is stored.
CustomField.label: Monthly Amount
